sections.heading: Mesh to VDBoperator
sections.content:
The Mesh to VDB operator can be used to convert input meshes into a density or SDF grid.

Grid type: the type of grid to convert the meshes into.

sections.heading: Density grid
sections.content: Grid name: the name of the target density grid.

sections.heading: SDF grid
sections.content: Grid name: the name of the target SDF grid.

sections.heading: Objects
sections.content: Object: the list of input objects to convert into an SDF grid.

sections.heading: Operation
sections.content: Operation: controls which boolean operation will be used to merge the mesh data into the VDB.
